card.name: Linking words before what something becomes or is used for
card.fires_on: Small linking words (is, are, provides, for, into, to, and) right where a sentence is about to say what something is turned into, used for, or made into. Mostly general web text about waste, materials, and products.

modes.label: Verb after a product or output
modes.description: A verb such as is, are or provides follows a noun for a product or result, before saying what it is useful for.
modes.example: converting it into a product that<< is>> useful for gardening and landscaping.

modes.label: Preposition of purpose or conversion
modes.description: A word like for, into or to comes before the thing something is made into or used for.
modes.example: render all waste<< into>> hydrogen gas, water, and organic fertilizer

modes.label: Verb of making or using
modes.description: A verb or linker in a list of items something was made into or used for.
modes.example: their shells were used to<< make>> dinnerware, jewelry and medicine

card.writes: It seems to push toward nouns for a kind of use or role (profession, visual, enquiry) and away from words about eating or consuming.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a sentence says what something is turned into or used for.
